title: Toolhouse: backend-as-a-service for AI agents
summary: Toolhouse is a sponsored backend-as-a-service for building, deploying and running AI agents with built-in RAG, memory, code execution and integrations (Gmail, Smithery, Zapier, Pipedream). It offers a no-code studio, voice-driven builder (Verb AI), an MCP server and a `th` CLI for defining and deploying agents as APIs.

research.description: Backend-as-a-service for AI agents with pre-loaded RAG, memory, code execution, browser automation and MCP server hookup. Provides the `th` CLI plus an SDK that integrates with Vercel AI and LlamaIndex.
